findings.issue: Ancestor guard command hashing used the two literal bytes backslash and zero instead of a NUL separator.
findings.impact: A genuine multiargument canonical guard receipt would fail authentication.
findings.requested_fix: Use the canonical NUL separator and test the runner's actual validator against a closed canonical multiargument guard receipt.
findings.history: Reported during static inspection; the snapshot retained here was taken after the author had repaired the separator. The earlier untested text was not separately snapshotted by this reviewer.

findings.issue: Prospective metadata antecedents had no explicit reserved-population exclusion before read_ref.
findings.impact: A misclassified prospective plan input could cross the metadata-only preflight boundary.
findings.requested_fix: Reject reserved population paths in metadata reads and test that failure occurs before opening the file.
